exposure: previous cesarean section (PCS vs no PCS)
termination of pregnancy with live fetuses in the second trimester (14-28 weeks)
outcome: success rate of fetal delivery within 48 h
cohort: 238 women undergoing second trimester (14-28 weeks) termination of pregnancy with live fetuses
finding: Intravaginal misoprostol is highly effective for second trimester termination of pregnancy with or without previous cesarean section, with similar success rates and induction to fetal delivery intervals, though uterine rupture can occur in those with previous cesarean section.
mod_finding: Intravaginal misoprostol is highly effective for second trimester termination of pregnancy in women with and without previous cesarean section, with similar success rates and induction to fetal delivery intervals.
